titolo: Ancient Structures Scientists Still Can't Explain

scene.testo: Some ancient structures should not exist at all.
Yet they have stood for thousands of years.
The Great Pyramid was the tallest building on Earth
Its builders stacked millions of stone blocks by hand.
Some granite beams weigh dozens of tons,
and they were hauled from quarries hundreds of miles away.
Scientists still debate exactly how it was done.
Now fly to Peru, high in the Andes.
Inca walls fit together without any mortar.
The stones are cut so tightly, a thin blade barely fits.
And these walls have survived centuries of earthquakes.
But that's not the strangest part.
At Stonehenge, some stones came from Wales,
Without wheels pulling carts, without modern machines.
Stay with me, because the next one is stranger.
